name: Talk to Cassius about his milk business

evidence.note: Speak to Cassius by the lake north-west of Lumbridge.

name: Ask Gillie about cow husbandry

evidence.note: Speak to Gillie in the cow field.

name: Ask Seth and find The Groats Principles

evidence.note: Talk to Seth and search the shelves for the book.

name: Bring Cassius the book and taste his milk

evidence.note: Give Cassius the book, drink the sample and talk to him again.

name: Discuss the milk business with Duke Horacio

evidence.note: Talk to the Duke upstairs in Lumbridge Castle.

name: Compare Gillie's milk and ask about Brutus

evidence.note: Drink Gillie's sample and continue her dialogue about the bull.

name: Defeat Brutus in the cow pen

evidence.note: Open the gate and defeat the level-30 bull. Avoid the slam and charge. Protect from Melee helps against ordinary hits.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat Brutus in the quest encounter.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Report Brutus's defeat to Gillie

evidence.note: Speak to Gillie after the fight.

name: Return to Cassius and finish the quest

evidence.note: Cassius finishes the quest and unlocks the repeatable boss.

name: Claim Gillie's Cowbell amulet and magic lamp

evidence.note: Speak to Gillie after completing the quest.

name: Buy ruff situation supplies

evidence.note: Purchase an estimated supply bundle at the Grand Exchange.

name: Offer to help Talia at the dog shelter

evidence.note: Talk to Talia about the missing puppies.

name: Ask Gertrude about the stray dog

evidence.note: Speak to Gertrude at her house.

name: Follow the stray dog to its den

evidence.note: Interact with the dog south of Varrock's west bank and follow it to the den.

name: Inspect the stray dog's den

evidence.note: Inspect the rough bedding, chewed box and torn newspaper. Interact with the dog so it can pick up the scent.

name: Follow the dog to the Cooks' Guild

evidence.note: Follow the dog and watch the cutscene north of the Cooks' Guild.

name: Ask Picklenose about the missing puppy

evidence.note: Dismiss any active pet, get the dog to follow and speak to Picklenose.

name: Sew a stuffed dog with needle and thread

evidence.note: Use grain on fur with a needle and thread.

name: Sew a stuffed dog with the Costume needle

evidence.note: Use grain on fur with the Costume needle.

name: Trade the stuffed dog for the pug puppy

evidence.note: Give Picklenose the toy, then pick up the puppy.

name: Follow the dog to the west wall

evidence.note: Follow the stray dog and watch the cutscene.

name: Defeat the two puppy thieves

evidence.note: Speak to the dog, then defeat the level-22 and level-23 outlaws.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat both outlaws and finish the encounter.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Collect the remaining rescued puppies at the den

evidence.note: Speak to the dog after the fight and collect the remaining labrador and spaniel at the den.

name: Return all three puppies to Talia

evidence.note: Hand the three puppies to Talia and unlock adoption.

name: Take the axe beside Marcellus

evidence.note: Take the axe from the log by Marcellus.

name: Hear Marcellus's side of the dispute

evidence.note: Talk to Marcellus at Locus Oasis.

name: Talk to the blue frogs

evidence.note: Speak to the frogs north-east of the oasis.

name: Report the blue frogs' concerns

evidence.note: Return to Marcellus.

name: Discuss Gary's plan

evidence.note: Speak to Sue and Gary about the flies.

name: Talk to the yellow frogs

evidence.note: Speak to Dave and Jane.

name: Chop the orange tree and sabotage the lily pad

evidence.note: Use an axe on the orange tree and sabotage the nearby lily pad.

name: Tell Sue and Gary about the lily pad

evidence.note: Return to the blue frogs.

name: Talk to Marcellus about the missing flies

evidence.note: Hear Marcellus's account.

name: Discuss the plan to frame the flies

evidence.note: Talk to Sue and Gary about their plan.

name: Open Marcellus's chest

evidence.note: Solve the chest code and take the frog plushy.

name: Plant the plushy and defeat Cuthbert

evidence.note: Plant the plushy at the dung and defeat Cuthbert.

planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Tell Marcellus what happened

evidence.note: Return to Marcellus with the outcome.

name: Resolve the dispute with Sue and Gary

evidence.note: Speak to Sue and Gary to finish and unlock the hardwood patch.

name: Buy vale totems supplies

evidence.note: Purchase an estimated supply bundle at the Grand Exchange.

name: Learn about spirit totems from Ranulph

evidence.note: Talk to Ranulph in western Auburnvale.

name: Build the oak totem base

evidence.note: Use a knife and oak log to build the base.

name: Ask Isadora how to carve spirit animals

evidence.note: Speak to Isadora about the visible spirits.

name: Carve the three visible spirit animals

evidence.note: Carve the matching animals into the totem.

name: Ask Isadora how to decorate the totem

evidence.note: Return to Isadora after carving.

name: Decorate the oak totem with four unstrung shortbows

evidence.note: Apply four matching oak decorations. The route uses oak shortbows (u).

name: Show Isadora the decorated totem

evidence.note: Speak to Isadora about the decorated totem.

name: Collect the tutorial offering

evidence.note: Collect the ent's offering. Its exact amount is in review.

name: Finish the tutorial with Isadora

evidence.note: Talk to Isadora to unlock the regular activity.

name: Buy a box trap from Imia

evidence.note: Pay Imia 41 coins for a box trap.

name: Pick up a needle in the guild

evidence.note: Pick up the needle in the south-east corner.

name: Pick up a hammer by Atza's house

evidence.note: Pick up the hammer in the house north of Atza.

name: Buy jerboa tails

evidence.note: Purchase an estimated supply bundle at the Grand Exchange.

name: Ask Apatura about the Hunters' Guild

evidence.note: Talk to Guildmaster Apatura on the surface.

name: Talk to Verity and obtain Wolf's toy mouse

evidence.note: Talk to the guild scribe and Wolf by the bar.

name: Distract Kiko and inspect its bed

evidence.note: Wind the toy mouse, distract Kiko and inspect the damaged bed.

name: Report Kiko's damaged bed to Wolf

evidence.note: Speak to Wolf before searching for Fox.

name: Find the injured Guild Hunter Fox

evidence.note: Talk to Fox near the savannah crevice.

name: Pick the smooth leaf

evidence.note: Search the bush near Fox.

name: Pick the sticky leaf at Locus Oasis

evidence.note: Search the rough-looking bush.

name: Catch two embertailed jerboas

evidence.note: Use a box trap to catch two jerboas for their tails.

name: Make a poultice and treat Fox

evidence.note: Combine the two leaves and a jerboa tail. Keep a second tail for Kiko's bed.

name: Set up Atza's equipment and receive trimmed fur

evidence.note: Bring the fur sample to Atza and use a hammer to set up the equipment pile. Collect the trimmed fur.

name: Get Fox's report

evidence.note: Return to Fox for his report.

name: Give Verity Fox's report

evidence.note: Talk to Verity in the guild basement.

name: Repair Kiko's bed

evidence.note: Use the remaining tail and trimmed fur on the bed with a needle.

name: Report to Apatura and finish the quest

evidence.note: Return to the surface and speak to Apatura. Master rumours have a separate Hunter gate.

name: Inspect the Grand Museum's empty display

evidence.note: Inspect the missing diadem display in Civitas illa Fortis.

name: Ask Curator Herminius about the diadem

evidence.note: Speak to Herminius in the Grand Museum.

name: Examine the tools and display

evidence.note: Inspect the tools left behind the case and examine the case again.

name: Question three museum visitors

evidence.note: Speak to a citizen, an academic and a tourist.

name: Ask Regulus Cento about suspicious travellers

evidence.note: Speak to Regulus south of the museum.

name: Take the crew's tattered sail

evidence.note: Ask a Trader Crewmember about the traveller and accept the sail repair.

name: Get Artima to repair the sail

evidence.note: Ask Artima at her crafting shop.

name: Return the sail and learn the next lead

evidence.note: Give the repaired sail to the crew and ask about the traveller.

name: Question Trader Stan or his crew in Port Sarim

evidence.note: Ask at the southern charter dock.

name: Question Betty and read her notes

evidence.note: Talk to Betty in the Port Sarim rune shop and read the notes.

name: Question Curator Haig Halen and take the key

evidence.note: Talk to Haig Halen, then pickpocket his storeroom key.

name: Search the storeroom crate for Xerna's diadem

evidence.note: Use the key to enter the north-east storeroom and search the crate.

name: Confront Haig Halen about the diadem

evidence.note: Show the diadem, fill the shame meter and finish the cutscene.

name: Report the recovery to Curator Herminius

evidence.note: Return to the Grand Museum and collect the fee.

name: Ask Emelio about his kebab stall

evidence.note: Talk to Emelio outside the south-eastern entrance to the city.

name: Ask the spice merchant about the missing delivery

evidence.note: Question the merchant in the Fortis Bazaar.

name: Ask Alba why the deliveries stopped

evidence.note: Speak to Alba in the farmhouse.

name: Defeat the Dire Wolf Alpha

evidence.note: Fight the alpha in the den. The pups attack with Ranged.

planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Report the wolf's defeat to Alba

evidence.note: Return to Alba to restore the supply chain.

name: Prepare Emelio's test recipe

evidence.note: Use four parts meat, two salad, one spice and three sauce.

name: Let Renata taste the kebab

evidence.note: Give the test kebab to Renata and hear her verdict.

name: Collect two kebabs for the Colosseum

evidence.note: Tell Emelio the recipe works and collect the two samples.

name: Offer Lelia one kebab sample

evidence.note: Offer a sample to Lelia and ask about selling kebabs.

name: Enter the trial arena with the remaining kebab

evidence.note: Tell Lelia you are ready and bring the remaining kebab.

name: Defeat the Colosseum minotaur

evidence.note: Eat the test kebab during the fight. Protect from Melee helps against ordinary attacks. When the minotaur shouts, Protect from Magic helps against its special attack.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Eat the kebab and defeat the minotaur.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Report the arena result to Lelia

evidence.note: Speak to Lelia after the fight.

name: Tell Emelio the advertising worked

evidence.note: Return to Emelio and unlock his kebab shop.

name: Talk to Patzi outside Villa Lucens

evidence.note: Speak to Patzi at the villa entrance.

name: Steal a butler's uniform

evidence.note: When the guard moves away, enter the window, search the wardrobe and leave.

name: Show Patzi the butler disguise

evidence.note: Speak to Patzi and finish the dialogue.

name: Equip the uniform and enter Villa Lucens

evidence.note: Wear the uniform and talk to the Head Butler. He holds your equipment during the investigation.

name: Question the party guests and report to Patzi

evidence.note: Speak to Patzi, then introduce yourself to Constantinius, Cozyac, Pavo and Xocotla before reporting back.

name: Find the antique wine

evidence.note: Look for the wine in the south room of the villa cellar.

name: Investigate the body in the east room

evidence.note: Check on the man in the cellar. The cutscene returns you to the ground floor.

name: Explain what happened to Stradius and Hutza

evidence.note: Speak to the guards and begin the investigation.

name: Inspect the six cellar clues

evidence.note: Inspect the entrance jug, box and stool in the south room, and the pottery, wine storage and Livius in the east room.

name: Interrogate the guests and brief the guards

evidence.note: Question the four guests, Patzi and Adala, then tell the guards what you found.

name: Pickpocket the suspects and inspect the evidence

evidence.note: Recover and inspect the wine labels, threatening note, drinking flask and shipping contract.

name: Tell the guards you are ready to accuse a suspect

evidence.note: Show the guards the evidence. Their dialogue takes you upstairs.

name: Confront Adala and get her confession

evidence.note: Question the suspects, accuse Adala and fight her unarmed. Get her confession and brief the guards.

name: Return to the Villa Lucens ground floor

evidence.note: Climb down both flights of stairs.

name: Ask Stradius about the theatre

evidence.note: After taking the cliff route, speak to Stradius by the theatre.

name: Investigate backstage and question the Costumer

evidence.note: Search the crate, bookshelf and costume rack. Ask about the actors, poison, costume and passage.

name: Report to Stradius and accuse Naiatli

evidence.note: Report the theatre evidence to Stradius.

name: Confront Naiatli and Clodius

evidence.note: Attack Naiatli when she runs and deal with Clodius when he appears.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Finish the theatre confrontation and speak to Naiatli.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Report to the guards at the villa

evidence.note: Speak to Stradius or Hutza and recover the possessions held during the quest.

name: Claim the Costume needle from the Costumer

evidence.note: Return to the theatre cellar and speak to the Costumer after the quest.
